verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird is a law firm. Its 'automation' offerings are fixed, firm-built questionnaire document generators (the SCC and Term Sheet generators, built on Contract Express). None of the evidence shows a user-authored automation platform where versioning, review, or rollback of the user's own automations would apply, so this axis does not fit the product type.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
